critique.evidence: Frame pacing is stable: long-frame ratio is 0 at all viewports; tablet/mobile average about 16.67ms with 16.8ms worst, while desktop averages 19.31ms with a 33.4ms worst. However, standard-mode sampling captured no motion at all: 0 active animations, 0 transitions, and 0 changed elements across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Reduced-motion mode produced no visual changes, but still reports 1 active animation and transitions on all 57 sampled elements. Therefore neither polished standard motion nor complete reduced-motion suppression is proven.
critique.fix: Provide measured frame sequences for purposeful economics-screen motion such as ledger-value transitions, ROI gauge movement, and interaction feedback. Keep them transform/opacity-based and verify their timing under load. Under prefers-reduced-motion, explicitly disable every animation and transition so instrumentation reports 0 active animations and 0 transition elements, then recapture across all three viewports.
